proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 708, what minimum foundation wall thickness and minimum depth below natural ground line are required for a Group A dwelling?

options.text: 250 mm minimum wall thickness; at least 600 mm below the natural ground line
200 mm minimum wall thickness; at least 900 mm below the natural ground line
300 mm minimum wall thickness; at least 750 mm below the natural ground line
100 mm minimum wall thickness; at least 450 mm below the natural ground line

proposed.rationale: Section 708 requires foundation walls for Group A dwellings to be at least 250 mm thick and to extend at least 600 mm below the natural ground line, with footings sized to safely transfer all loads to the soil.
proposed.explanation: The 250 mm thickness and 600 mm depth are the Section 708 minimums for Group A dwellings; deeper or thicker foundations may be required by soil-bearing conditions, referral codes, or local ordinances, but these are the code baseline.
